article.story: CAPE GIRARDEAU, Mo. -- — DeAndre Craig had 16 points, six rebounds and five assists as Purdue Fort Wayne beat Southeast Missouri State 80-75 on Tuesday night. Edir Ortiz shot 6 for 10, including 4 for 7 from beyond the arc to add 16 points for the Mastodons (5-2). Tamaje Izuagbe went 5 of 8 from the field (2 for 3 from 3-point range) to finish with 12 points. Fontaine Williams finished with 17 points and two steals for the Redhawks (3-4). Alonzo Clawson-Smith added 17 points and two steals for Southeast Missouri State. Drew Cooper finished with 11 points. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
